mostWorthwhile.text: Creating the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: the explanation made seawater circulation through hot rock understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating the volcano was relatively predictable, although the explanation of rising magma was useful.

arbitrary.text: The continent was an indirect route to sea minerals at first, but rainfall, weathering and rivers subsequently made its purpose clear. No action ultimately felt arbitrary.
